ai_usage_evidence: describing the prompting strategy used to direct an AI agent (Claude)
summary: The submission is a single PDF that serves as a companion methodology report for the five required tasks. It outlines a prompting workflow (Decompose → Delegate → Verify → Converge) and provides the specific prompts used for each task: Task 1 (Inventory), Task 2 (Topographical Mapping), Task 3 (Synthesis & Divergence), Task 4 (Integrative Synthesis), and Task 5 (Final Report). The document details how prompts were structured to extract data, build hierarchies, synthesize findings, design architectures, and craft an executive briefing, all using the AI model Claude.
issues: The report describes prompting strategy rather than presenting the actual deliverable outputs (tables, maps, synthesis).
No bibliography or reference list is included.
Content focuses on methodology, which may be insufficient if the assignment expects the final artifacts themselves.
